title: Insecure CAPTCHA - step parameter bypass (no reCAPTCHA verification on final step)
proof: Source code confirms step=2 flow skips reCAPTCHA check entirely (no recaptcha_check_answer call). Sending POST with step=2&password_new=X&password_conf=X&Change=Change changes password without any CAPTCHA verification. reCAPTCHA API key is missing from config, making step=1 always fail.
